Before I can give my final approval on the finale plan, we need to get through the final greenlight meeting — that includes the broadcast-standards review and the audience-technology readiness review. I understand the audience tech team is estimating as many as 15,000 remote viewers may try to participate, so we need to make sure everyone's ready for that volume. As part of our sign-off policy, each review lead will need to read their confirmed requirements into the meeting record using the formal review disclosure. Once that's done, I'll go through my final sign-off checklist and credit every confirmed review source the locked plan relies on before I close the meeting. Let's get started — who's ready to walk through their review?
